views.title: Scenario, description and occurrence
views.note: Scenario is a second-order type; realization does not follow merely from its existence.

views.title: Risk patterns and situational context
views.note: Orange nodes are broad patterns. Exposure now has registered subject/source links; endpoint existence does not entail a risk score or outcome.

views.title: Assessment activity and result distinctions
views.note: Dimension and control-baseline subkinds may overlap. The ontology does not impose a universal score formula.

views.title: Observation, evidence and monitoring
views.note: Evidence is a contextual role. Provenance is an external pattern reference; supporting evidence does not establish truth.

views.title: Treatment specification and execution
views.note: Plan, strategy, activity and control remain distinct. A control association does not prove effectiveness.

views.title: Responsibility and explicit grounding
views.note: Green profile mediation needs distinct Endurants. External Actor identity is not supplied locally; Risk Owner has no new sortal identity.

views.title: Register, description and workflow snapshot
views.note: Unqualified hasWorkflowState is a snapshot; use the separate qualified workflow view for historical answers.

views.title: Managed artifacts, versions and content
views.note: Version/content multiplicities are strict data-profile requirements. Shared content does not merge artifact identity.

views.title: Result inheritance and qualified profile
views.note: All shown named subclass axioms are asserted in rc.3; no new disjointness between independent result dimensions.

views.title: Qualified numeric assessment profile
views.note: Opt-in SHACL profile. Numeric Scale Version inherits ArtifactVersion identity; equal intervals do not merge versions.

views.title: Scheme-qualified temporal workflow
views.note: Exactly one record/value/scheme per assignment. Half-open intervals; no overlap for the same record and scheme.

views.title: Enterprise and pharmaceutical references
views.note: External endpoint references preserve their own identity. No invented CM-PharmE equivalence or asserted global domain.

views.title: Generic relations and extension metadata
views.note: A generic association is not causality. Dashed extension is registry metadata, not an OWL property.

views.title: Assessment context and indicator links
views.note: These typed endpoint projections do not narrow globally open property domains. External and planned concepts stay distinct.

views.title: External references and planned concepts
views.note: Twelve reference slots: four registry markers and eight undeclared candidates. No implied implementation or equivalence.

limits: Unclassified broad patterns and external endpoints are intentional
RoleMixin external sortal specializations remain outside this core
Not a complete OntoUML antipattern detector
Full atlas is supplementary; IEEE fit is measured separately
